name: Chicken Fajitas
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring stir-fried chicken, peppers, and onions, served with tortillas and various toppings.
recipeIngredient: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.text: Stir-fry the vegetables and chicken over high heat until the chicken is cooked through with spices.
Add Catalina dressing and heat through.
Serve wrapped in flour tortillas with shredded cheese, salsa, sour cream, and guacamole as garnishes.
